item.title: Flour sacks turned flood barriers: Gaza faces another winter without safe shelter
item.description: Like many people in the war-ravaged Gaza Strip, Ahmed Al-Omari is preparing for another winter of bitter cold and rain that threatens to cause flooding as families struggle to survive in tattered tents and damaged buildings.

item.title: Powerful Council Members Reject A-Baki in First Color-Coded Poll
item.description: The five permanent members of the United Nations Security Council roundly rejected the candidacy of Tonga-nominated Ivonne A-Baki for secretary-general in the members’ first secret color-coded straw poll, on Oct. 16.
